fusions.name: Marrow Bone
fusions.desc: A worrying bite that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Pack Mealtime
fusions.desc: Bites at everything round you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its effect rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Shared Scraps
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power for 12 seconds, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Hound Under the Table
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
